page.overview:
Who is McGreevey?

McGreevey was a male officer in the science division of the 24th century Starfleet.

McGreevey served during the Dominion War in 2375. He was assigned to AR-558, a planet that the Federation Alliance had captured from the Dominion, under the command of Captain . They were assigned to protect the planet's communication array. Other members of the 150-person unit included Commander , , Crewman , Vargas and Lieutenant Nadia Larkin.

McGreevey was extremely talkative, and was intensely disliked by his fellow soldier, Vargas, who thought he was a "jerk" he "couldn't stand", complained that McGreevey "wouldn't shut up. Yap, yap, yap, yap. He thought he was the world's greatest authority on everything."

During a battle, McGreevey had been tending Vargas's wound at the time and, as usual, "talking his head off, and the next minute he's lying flat on his back with a hole in his . And I just sat there and I looked at him. That was so great. He was so quiet. One time in his life he's quiet."
